winCondition: Phase 1: within 7 hours every psychic must guess their character, location and object from the ghost's visions, otherwise everyone loses. Phase 2: the ghost sends a shared vision of 3 cards; the psychics vote (ties broken by clairvoyancy track, then eldest voter). If the chosen group contains the true culprit all players win, otherwise all lose.

endCondition.description: Seven game hours, then the culprit reveal phase

notes: family: coop-deduction. The ghost plays on the winning side. No points: clairvoyancy track only decides vote timing and tie-breaks. Expansions (Hidden Signs, Secrets and Lies) not modelled. Rules checked against a secondary rules summary because the Libellud rulebook PDF could not be downloaded.
